80768.body:

Happy Tuesday good degens! Lots of stuff going on!
Let’s dive in!
As always… stats/alerts/etc at top and tweets/news/links/videos/etc at bottom… and all tweets are hyperlinked so just click on them to pull them up on Twitter/X!

Spotlight
Take note friends! Institutional-grade trading vaults are here, and INFINIT aka @Infinit_Labs [ https://substack.com/redirect/14ce8e83-abee-4823-9dbe-e3eaffd94dfe?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] is bringing them onchain!
In the past, institutional-grade trading has been widely inaccessible for most investors…. Defi infrastructure helps with access, but figuring out which teams are credible and which vaults are likely to perform well is still very difficult... 
But now INFINIT- one of your humble froggish editor’s favorite projects in all of crypto- brings those pieces together! 
They are providing professional trading teams, live track records, managers putting their own capital at risk, and clear standards for how vaults operate!
To explain further… APEX MS is the first institutional-grade trading vault deployed on INFINIT, operated by Apex Quantitative Capital…
APEX’s team brings close to 50 years of combined experience across traditional finance and crypto, supported by INFINIT’s proprietary AI tooling to identify trading signals and continually refine strategies. 
Its first vault, APEX MS, has already delivered astonishingly solid returns, as you can read about in the article below!
And now the next opportunity is coming! APEX MS2 deposits are planned to open October 28th and close November 11th!
Follow @Infinit_Labs [ https://substack.com/redirect/14ce8e83-abee-4823-9dbe-e3eaffd94dfe?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] for the deposit details + ongoing updates!
And make sure to read the article below…
